response.overview: Yes, parts of MSC Cruises operate 24/7, including digital booking platforms and select onboard services, while general customer service lines and specific ship amenities have limited hours. Contact or Call +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) +44-289-708-0062 (UK)  Digital and Online Services (24/7) Website and Mobile App: You can access the MSC Cruises Website around the clock to browse itineraries, make new bookings, and manage existing reservations. Onboard Wi-Fi: Internet access in public areas on MSC ships is available 24 hours a day (with purchased internet packages). Onboard and Phone Services (Limited Hours) Customer Service Phone Lines: Standard phone support is not always fully staffed 24/7 and usually operates during specific business hours depending on your region. Ship Venues: Onboard amenities like main dining rooms, specialty restaurants, shops, and entertainment venues follow specific daily schedules rather than running round-the-clock.
response.title: 【Official~Guide】 Does MSC cruise work on 24/7?
